frame.atomicity: Snapshot is serialized under the sole OwnedRuntime lock; work gate atomics can advance independently; compare quiescent frames/deltas. Counters reset only at next admitted runtime epoch.

native_test_declarations.name: ownedTestGate
native_test_declarations.signature: (runtime: String, kind: Int, enabled: Int): Unit
native_test_declarations.semantics: Existing kind0 before compute and kind1 before source publication remain; kind2 after first terminal assignment but before Work exit. enabled0 releases and is allowed during Closing. kind2 remains held across explicit close; actual env teardown releases via allowed predicate. Actual worker identity and terminal witness are fields4-6.

native_test_declarations.name: ownedTestDelivery
native_test_declarations.semantics: action0 arms one selected valid subscription, 1 reads frame, 2 releases its real taken lease. Takes occur only in ownedDeliver. At most one held lease per runtime. Release returns before invoke/discard; existing pollRuntime/progress completes it even if facade stopped traversing that subscription. Stopped/closing leases discard. New State replaces the model on the same pre-entry Ticket: StateTickets stays1 and Entered stays0; its new source obligation must finish before invoke. Event retains FIFO. Stop/physical join return source ownership separately from the held Delivery owner.

native_test_declarations.name: ownedTestPublication
native_test_declarations.signature: (snapshot: Snapshot, engine: String, stream: Int): Unit
native_test_declarations.semantics: stream0 State,1 Event. Holds one actual fully cloned/reserved transaction in existing owner; retained bytes and source/event gauges include reservation. This is distinct from legacy kind1 worker source gate.

native_test_declarations.name: ownedTestReleasePublication
native_test_declarations.semantics: commit0 abandon,1 commit. Allowed after Closing. Every selected subscription is validated before any enqueue; stop/close causes full abandon then Closing. Held source ownership keeps selected subscription and engine ACK pending until released. Release only wakes worker/ready; no listener invocation.

native_test_declarations.name: ownedTestClone
native_test_declarations.signature: (engine: String, nth: Int, mode: Int): Unit
native_test_declarations.semantics: nth1..8 actual adapter clones, mode0 failure before allocation,mode1 non-null native allocation with error. Both return ResourceExhausted; caller first owns/releases non-null error. Single shot applies to next actual clones including publication recipients/scratch. Counts include all actual adapter allocations/releases; no hypothetical OOM claim. Arms clear on engine retirement.

native_test_declarations.name: ownedTestTransfer
native_test_declarations.semantics: phase1 after actual result/watch admission and before return encoding (existing AdmissionReturn rolls back); phase2 before consuming guard preserves native waiter/model; phase3 after consuming guard releases exactly once. One shot at the selected real boundary. This is a controlled Kotlin boundary failure, not a claim of actual NAPI returned error.

native_test_declarations.name: ownedTestInspect
native_test_declarations.semantics: Read-only control frame; allowed during logical Closing and after facade BridgeFailure while native metadata still owned. It does not poll/progress or claim closure. Existing bootstrap/static R6 audit remains separate.

native_test_declarations.name: ownedTestHandle
native_test_declarations.signature: (handle: String, kind: Int, case: Int): Unit
native_test_declarations.semantics: Public facade passes only a typed valid resource private handle. kind0 engine,1 operation,2 subscription; case0 unchanged,1 wrong-kind,2 prior generation (requires current generation>1),3 decimal overflow,4 leading-zero,5 embedded NUL. Executes same production target/operation/subscription admission without provider/work admission. No arbitrary raw handle public API.

error_expectations.transfer_phase1: BridgeFailure with original claim rollback; result claim can retry with fresh monotonic waiter id
error_expectations.transfer_phase2: BridgeFailure with native residual retained; do not treat as normal close ACK
error_expectations.transfer_phase3: Generated NAPI global boundary reports DeliveryFailureConsumed after actual guard disposal; internal Kotlin fault is BridgeFailure
error_expectations.handle_case2: InvalidHandleRetired after generation>1; InvalidArgument when no prior positive generation exists

facade_work_owned_by_spec.settling: test-only one-shot callback/throw after actual waiter.accept or waiter.reject returns and before finally clears waiter.settling/removes Map entry; include immediate watch-close accept; reentrant 33rd admission must see 32 charged waiters
facade_work_owned_by_spec.typed_wrappers: Use actual resource handle from checked facade object for sub/engine/handle controls, runtime key only for runtime controls. Do not pass engine.testKey() as engine handle; legacy testKey() returns runtime key.

not_implemented_or_not_proven: Real live foreign-env Kotlin observation key: main-env-only single managed owner has no second admitted foreign env source; this helper deliberately supports cases0..5 only, never fabricates case6.
No NAPI API-attempt counters added; existing R6/static evidence remains independent and absent counters must not be filled with zero.
No wrong identity DSO fixtures in this patch; delegated producer fixture task remains separate.
JVM host checks stub allocation, native worker/join, TSFN and NAPI; target tests and actual Release compilation still required.
